## Pull Request Checklist

- [ ] Summary: one-line description of the change and motivation.
- [ ] Files changed: list of changed files and any scenes/prefabs that need re-wiring.
- [ ] Manual Play-mode test steps included (see CONTRIBUTING.md for template).
- [ ] Confirmed inspector references for serialized fields remain assigned.
- [ ] If ScriptableObjects or assets were added, list their paths.

Add additional notes for reviewers (risks, special run steps):
